sections.title: Tests to do at home
sections.summary: The jar test now; the squeeze, percolation and worm count tests to come

blocks.subject: jar-test
blocks.caption: A jar test after a day

items: Fill a straight-sided jar a third full of soil from the bed, with stones and roots picked out.
Top it up with water to near the brim and add a teaspoon of dish soap.
Shake hard for a few minutes, then set it down where it won't be moved.
After 1 minute, mark the top of the sand.
After 6 hours, mark the top of the silt.
When the water clears, a day or two later, mark the top of the clay.
Each layer's height divided by the total height is its share. Find the point on the texture triangle.
